subject: Sea Trials - East Coast
text:
Sea Trials - East Coast
An Autonomous Surface Vehicle (ASV) will operate within Holyrood Bay, Conception Bay within the following area from November 16 2026 to May 18 2027 1130UTC to 2130UTC daily.
South of Chapels Cove 47 26.110N 053 09.146W
The ASV is 3.7m long, 1.2m tall, and has a beam of 0.9m. It is red and white in colour with a distinctive ring on the back. Requesting wide berth. Support vessel Moses Apaqaq can be contacted on VHF 09.
 
Caution.
